name: Fateful Revelations
body:
School divination [void]; Level psychic 9, shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, witch 9

Casting Time 1 hour

Components V, S, DF, M (see text)

Range personal

Effect glimpse the future

Duration instantaneous

Void: Spells with this descriptor are tied with a philosophical school of magic based on a concept known as the Void. The school teaches that the Void is the nothingness from which springs forth creativity, insight, spirit, thought, and also the source of pure energy from which all elements and phenomena are derived. Channeling the power of the Void (or the Void element) allows for the manipulation of the elements in objects and creatures, among other possibilities. Spells with the void descriptor are considered to belong to the Void element (for geomancers) and the void elemental school (for void elementalists).

If a spell has the [void] descriptor, it cannot be dispelled by elements release regardless of how high is your CL.

You project your consciousness with the power of the Void out into the world, revealing to you moments of the future. While you cannot alter the future you witnessed, you can be better prepared to deal with them when they occur.

Original Strength	Duration of Lingering Spirit Aura
Faint	1d6 rounds
Moderate	1d6 minutes
Strong	1d6 x 10 minutes
Overwhelming	1d6 days
Spirit Aura’s Source	Aura Power
None	Faint	Moderate	Strong	Overwhelming
Fey (HD)	4 or lower	5-10	11-25	26-50	51 or higher
Incorporeal Undead (HD)	–	2 or lower	3-8	9-20	21 or higher
Outsider (HD)	–	1 or lower	2-4	5-10	11 or higher
Magic Item or Spell (CL)	5th or lower	6th-10th	11th-15th	16th-20th	21st or higher

Upon completing the hour-long meditation and incantations required to cast this spell, you may then sacrifice a permanent magic item (not single-use or consumable) worth at least 5,000 gold pieces. In doing so, you submit a single inquiry to the GM concerning the current campaign. The inquiry must be one that can be answered by the GM with a single sentence and it must involve the future in some manner. While the GM must answer truthfully, the answer can be cryptic, vague, or clear as they see fit. You are aware during the casting time if a particular inquiry you are meditating on can be answered by the GM in this way.

If the permanent magic item is worth at least 10,000 gold pieces or 15,000 gold pieces, you may submit up to 2 or 3 inquiries respectively per casting of this spell.

For the purposes of this spell, the moments of the future revealed must be at least 24 hours ahead from the moment you complete the casting of this spell.

However, you are unaware of the exact time when the future you witnessed will occur but perceptive players may be able to deduce a general estimate.

But I Don’t Want to Reveal…

For some GMs, they may not wish to reveal the truth involving the current campaign as described by fateful revelations, despite it being a 9th level spell (or 8th level for those with the Void Core Cultivator feat), for whatever reason. Instead of outright saying nope, you may instead grant them the benefits of moment of prescience as an extraordinary ability for a number of future encounters equal to twice the number of questions they would have been able to ask with fateful revelations.
